note: These figures come from Ministerial statements and independent economic modelling, not from the weekly programme data. They are updated by hand when a new primary figure is published, and each links to its source.

kpis.label: Livestock export revenue lost each year
kpis.sub: Fresh and frozen beef R3.7 billion, sheep and goat meat R1.4 billion and live animals R502.4 million. Average annual loss from closed export markets, based on the previous year's export statistics.
kpis.source: Minister of Agriculture, written reply to Parliament, reported by Business Day, 22 December 2025

kpis.label: State spending on vaccines
kpis.sub: Spent on vaccine procurement and deployment up to 1 June 2026. On 22 September the Department told Parliament it had asked National Treasury for a further R1.3 billion in the 2026/27 adjustments budget, because its own budget cannot sustain procurement.
kpis.source: Minister of Agriculture, statement of 1 June 2026; Department of Agriculture presentation to the Portfolio Committee, 22 September 2026

kpis.label: Production value lost, 2025 to 2035
kpis.sub: Updated BFAP modelling of gross production value lost against the pre-outbreak baseline. Beef exports fell to about 7,700 tonnes in January to April 2026, from about 14,100 tonnes a year earlier.
kpis.source: BFAP, presented at Nampo Alfa, reported by Farmer's Weekly, 5 October 2026
